rows.label: THETA WAVE
rows.clue: The normal brainwave in the encephalogram of a person who is awake but relaxed and drowsy

rows.label: SHEAR
rows.clue: (physics) a deformation of an object in which parallel planes remain parallel but are shifted in a direction parallel to themselves

rows.label: JET STREAM
rows.clue: A high-speed high-altitude airstream blowing from west to east near the top of the troposphere

rows.label: EAST WIND
rows.clue: A wind from the east

rows.label: SUNLIGHT
rows.clue: The rays of the sun

rows.label: OIL PRESSURE
rows.clue: Pressure that keeps oil on the moving parts of an internal-combustion engine

rows.label: NORTH WIND
rows.clue: A wind that blows from the north

rows.label: MOONLIGHT
rows.clue: The light of the Moon

rows.label: FLUKE
rows.clue: A stroke of luck

rows.label: TAILWIND
rows.clue: Wind blowing in the same direction as the path of a ship or aircraft

rows.label: REFRACTION
rows.clue: The change in direction of a propagating wave (light or sound) when passing from one medium to another

rows.label: REPULSION
rows.clue: The force by which bodies repel one another

rows.label: BOND
rows.clue: An electrical force linking atoms

rows.label: COLOR FORCE
rows.clue: (physics) the interaction that binds protons and neutrons together in the nuclei of atoms

rows.label: FRESH GALE
rows.clue: Wind moving 39-46 knots

rows.label: FROST HEAVE
rows.clue: Upthrust of ground or pavement caused by the freezing of moist soil

rows.label: FOOD PYRAMID
rows.clue: (ecology) a hierarchy of food chains with the principal predator at the top

rows.label: ENERGY LEVEL
rows.clue: A definite stable energy that a physical system can have

rows.label: TORCHLIGHT
rows.clue: Light from a torch or torches

rows.label: EFFECT
rows.clue: A phenomenon that follows and is caused by some previous phenomenon

rows.label: LASER BEAM
rows.clue: A beam of light generated by a laser

rows.label: HAIL
rows.clue: Precipitation of ice pellets when there are strong rising air currents

rows.label: FAIR WEATHER
rows.clue: Moderate weather

rows.label: CARRIER WAVE
rows.clue: A radio wave that can be modulated in order to transmit a signal

rows.label: NEAR GALE
rows.clue: Wind moving 32-38 knots

rows.label: RED SHIFT
rows.clue: (astronomy) a shift in the spectra of very distant galaxies toward longer wavelengths (toward the red end of the spectrum)

rows.label: INFRARED RAY
rows.clue: A ray of infrared radiation

rows.label: HIGH BEAM
rows.clue: The beam of a car's headlights that provides distant illumination

rows.label: FUME
rows.clue: A cloud of fine particles suspended in a gas

rows.label: ELECTRICITY
rows.clue: A physical phenomenon associated with stationary or moving electrons and protons

rows.label: HEAT RAY
rows.clue: A ray that produces a thermal effect

rows.label: UPDRAFT
rows.clue: A strong upward air current

rows.label: SQUALL LINE
rows.clue: A cold front along which squalls or thunderstorms are likely

rows.label: AFFINITY
rows.clue: (immunology) the attraction between an antigen and an antibody

rows.label: ION BEAM
rows.clue: A beam of ions moving in the same direction at the same speed

rows.label: DUST CLOUD
rows.clue: A cloud of dust suspended in the air

rows.label: FORCE FIELD
rows.clue: The space around a radiating body within which its electromagnetic oscillations can exert force on another similar body not in contact with it

rows.label: RESONANCE
rows.clue: An excited state of a stable particle causing a sharp maximum in the probability of absorption of electromagnetic radiation

rows.label: STARLIGHT
rows.clue: The light of the stars

rows.label: AEROSOL
rows.clue: A cloud of solid or liquid particles in a gas

rows.label: SCORCHER
rows.clue: An extremely hot day

rows.label: BETA RAY
rows.clue: Radiation of beta particles during radioactive decay

rows.label: ATTRACTION
rows.clue: The force by which one object attracts another

rows.label: SHORT WAVE
rows.clue: A radio wave with a wavelength less than 100 meters (a frequency greater than 3 megahertz)

rows.label: LONG WAVE
rows.clue: A radio wave with a wavelength longer than a kilometer (a frequency below 300 kilohertz)

rows.label: EXCHANGE
rows.clue: Chemical process in which one atom or ion or group changes places with another

rows.label: SKIN EFFECT
rows.clue: The tendency of high-frequency alternating current to distribute near the surface of a conductor

rows.label: PARALLAX
rows.clue: The apparent displacement of an object as seen from two different points that are not on a line with the object

rows.label: IMPEDANCE
rows.clue: A material's opposition to the flow of electric current

rows.label: HIGH WIND
rows.clue: A very strong wind

rows.label: LIFE CYCLE
rows.clue: A series of stages through which an organism passes between recurrences of a primary stage

rows.label: INDUCTANCE
rows.clue: An electrical phenomenon whereby an electromotive force (EMF) is generated in a closed circuit by a change in the flow of current

rows.label: MISHAP
rows.clue: An unpredictable outcome that is unfortunate

rows.label: ATOMIC POWER
rows.clue: Nuclear energy regarded as a source of electricity for the power grid (for civilian use)

rows.label: LIGHT AIR
rows.clue: Wind moving 1-3 knots

rows.label: GALE
rows.clue: A strong wind moving 45-90 knots

rows.label: WEAK FORCE
rows.clue: (physics) an interaction between elementary particles involving neutrinos or antineutrinos that is responsible for certain kinds of radioactive decay

rows.label: SEA BREEZE
rows.clue: A cooling breeze from the sea (during the daytime)

rows.label: MASS DEFECT
rows.clue: The amount by which the mass of an atomic nucleus is less than the sum of the masses of its constituent particles

rows.label: GAMMA RAY
rows.clue: Electromagnetic radiation emitted during radioactive decay and having an extremely short wavelength

rows.label: SKY WAVE
rows.clue: A radio wave that is reflected back to earth by the ionosphere or a communications satellite

rows.label: SUCTION
rows.clue: A force over an area produced by a pressure difference

rows.label: WAVE FRONT
rows.clue: All the points just reached by a wave as it propagates

rows.label: RAIN SHOWER
rows.clue: A brief period of precipitation

rows.label: SUNBEAM
rows.clue: A ray of sunlight

rows.label: DEPOSIT
rows.clue: The phenomenon of sediment or gravel accumulating

rows.label: CALM AIR
rows.clue: Wind moving at less than 1 knot

rows.label: SNOW
rows.clue: Precipitation falling from clouds in the form of ice crystals

rows.label: INVERSION
rows.clue: The layer of air near the earth is cooler than an overlying layer

rows.label: AIR PRESSURE
rows.clue: The pressure exerted by the atmosphere

rows.label: SNOW EATER
rows.clue: A warm dry wind blowing down the eastern slopes of the Rockies

rows.label: HEAT WAVE
rows.clue: A wave of unusually hot weather

rows.label: FOCAL POINT
rows.clue: A point of convergence of light (or other radiation) or a point from which it diverges

rows.label: FIELD LINE
rows.clue: An imaginary line in a field of force

rows.label: SPECTRUM
rows.clue: An ordered array of the components of an emission or wave

rows.label: CORONA
rows.clue: The outermost region of the sun's atmosphere

rows.label: MIDNIGHT SUN
rows.clue: The sun visible at midnight (inside the Arctic or Antarctic Circles)

rows.label: LATENT HEAT
rows.clue: Heat absorbed or radiated during a change of phase at a constant temperature and pressure

rows.label: TRAJECTORY
rows.clue: The path followed by an object moving through space

rows.label: ENERGY
rows.clue: (physics) a thermodynamic quantity equivalent to the capacity of a physical system to do work

rows.label: WIND POWER
rows.clue: Power derived from the wind (as by windmills)

rows.label: FORTUNE
rows.clue: An unknown and unpredictable phenomenon that causes an event to result one way rather than another

rows.label: FOOD CHAIN
rows.clue: (ecology) a community of organisms where each member is eaten in turn by another member

rows.label: WALLOP
rows.clue: A forceful consequence

rows.label: AFTERGLOW
rows.clue: A glow sometimes seen in the sky after sunset

rows.label: LEVERAGE
rows.clue: The mechanical advantage gained by being in a position to use a lever

rows.label: SNOW FLURRY
rows.clue: A light brief snowfall and gust of wind (or something resembling that)

rows.label: LIGHT
rows.clue: (physics) electromagnetic radiation that can produce a visual sensation

rows.label: HYSTERESIS
rows.clue: The lagging of an effect behind its cause

rows.label: SLEET
rows.clue: Partially melted snow (or a mixture of rain and snow)

rows.label: CONDUCTION
rows.clue: The transmission of heat or electricity or sound

rows.label: MIST
rows.clue: A thin fog with condensation near the ground

rows.label: SANDBLAST
rows.clue: A blast of wind laden with sand

rows.label: SPRINKLE
rows.clue: A light shower that falls in some locations and not others nearby

rows.label: AMPERAGE
rows.clue: The strength of an electrical current measured in amperes

rows.label: INTERRUPT
rows.clue: A signal that temporarily stops the execution of a program so that another procedure can be carried out
